Hi Alex — good catch. Looks like the invite used CET but the auto-converter dropped a digit and made it 01:00 PST; we run demos out of both EU and US teams and want to avoid middle-of-night slots.

Two CET-friendly options that our engineer and I can cover:
- Monday 16 Feb, 16:00 CET (07:00 PST) — Redwood EU engineer will lead; 40m
- Tuesday 17 Feb, 10:00 CET (01:00 PST) — earlier in EMEA morning, but it's late for PST.

If the EMEA execs prefer morning CET, option 2 is fine — otherwise option 1 is safer given US participant constraints. Can you confirm preferred slot? I can send a corrected invite (redwood-demo-invite.ics) once you confirm.

Also note: our scheduling system flagged a DST/settings mismatch for a small subset of calendar clients — not the DST date itself but some calendar clients are defaulting to UTC offsets. If you or Emma see odd offsets in the updated invite, please let me know.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
